1. Multiply the colors by alpha.
2. Find the output size, grown to fit the turned corners or kept.
3. For every output pixel, turn its center back by the angle into the source.
4. Read the value there, with nearest, bilinear or bicubic interpolation. Outside the source the value is 0.
5. Lay the fill color under the result, divide the colors by alpha and round to 8 bits.
